description: Every reward make.fun granted your account, newest first, as GET /api/me/grants answers it: each with its token and amount (amount in the token's units, amount_base_units in its base units), the reason it was granted, its icon, its status (claimable: claim it before expires_at, null meaning it never expires; held or sending: claimed, being paid, a held one with its words; paid, with tx_signature and explorer_url; expired; revoked: withdrawn), and once claimed the destination it pays. claim: what a claim asks now (tax_details_required with tax_threshold_usd, pinned_destination, your wallets) and setup, a sentence while rewards cannot be claimed on this server yet (null otherwise). Claim a claimable one with claim_grant. Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.
name: list_grants
title: Your rewards from make.fun
